sources.title: Welcome KB-Whisper, a new fine-tuned Swedish Whisper model!
sources.snippet: KBLab proudly presents KB-Whisper, a speech to text model fine-tuned using 50,000 hours of transcribed speech. This work reports an overall improvement across model sizes compared to OpenAI's Whisper evaluated on Swedish. Most notably, we report an average 47% reduction in WER comparing our best performing model to OpenAI's Whisper-large-v3, in evaluations across FLEURS, Common Voice, and NST.
